note: 21 hook formulas for X. On X the hook is the first line - the only line the timeline shows before the fold. It does three jobs: earn the tap on 'show more', raise a question the reader cannot close, and prove a payoff exists. A hook that only does the third is a summary and it is scrolled past. Every formula here carries the shape, a worked example, the failure mode, and the patterns hookscore.py classifies against.
rules: The first line must work alone. Most people never tap 'show more'.
One idea. A first line carrying two promises keeps neither.
Specific beats big. '400 to 200,000 in seven months' outperforms 'massive growth'.
No throat-clearing. 'Let me explain', 'Here's the thing' and 'Unpopular opinion:' are folds, not hooks.
A thread's first line is a post's first line. Same job, same rules.

hooks.name: The Statistic
hooks.shape: A number the reader did not know, stated flat, then the consequence.
hooks.example: 97% of people who start posting quit before post 30. Here is what the other 3% do.
hooks.fails_when: Dies if the number is vague or unverifiable. Say the source in the next line.

hooks.name: Someone Else's Result
hooks.shape: A named person's outcome, then the mechanism.
hooks.example: This account went from 400 to 200,000 followers in seven months on one format. I mapped it.
hooks.fails_when: Do not invent the number. If you cannot name the account, use a different formula.

hooks.name: The Mistake
hooks.shape: Name the error the reader is probably making right now.
hooks.example: Your first line is why nobody taps 'show more'. It is not the topic.
hooks.fails_when: Only works if the mistake is common and the reader can check it in one second.

hooks.name: Contrarian Flip
hooks.shape: State the accepted advice, then reject it.
hooks.example: Everyone says post daily. I posted once a week for a year and tripled my reach.
hooks.fails_when: Needs evidence in the next two lines or it reads as contrarian for its own sake.

hooks.name: The Reveal
hooks.shape: Promise a specific thing will be shown, then show it.
hooks.example: I am going to show you the exact prompt that wrote this post.
hooks.fails_when: You have to actually show it, early. A reveal in the last line is a fold at the first.

hooks.name: The Superlative
hooks.shape: The single best/worst/fastest of a category.
hooks.example: This is the fastest way to turn one long video into thirty posts.
hooks.fails_when: Superlatives are cheap. Earn it by naming what it beat.

hooks.name: The Clock
hooks.shape: Bound the payoff in time.
hooks.example: In the next 90 seconds you will have a working hook and a post for tomorrow.
hooks.fails_when: The clock has to be true. Overrun it and the next post's hook is not believed.

hooks.name: I Tried It
hooks.shape: First-person experiment with a stated cost.
hooks.example: I let an AI run my account for 30 days. I did not touch a single post.
hooks.fails_when: Needs a real cost - time, money, risk - or there is no stake.

hooks.name: The Question
hooks.shape: Ask the exact question the reader is already asking.
hooks.example: Why does your post die at the fold when the topic is fine?
hooks.fails_when: Must be the reader's question, not yours. Pull it from your own replies.

hooks.name: Before and After
hooks.shape: Two states, one cut between them.
hooks.example: This was my bio. This is my bio now. Same offer, four times the follows.
hooks.fails_when: Only works with a visual. Do not use it on a text-only post.

hooks.name: The Teardown
hooks.shape: Take a real thing apart in public.
hooks.example: I pulled the nine best-performing posts of the month and broke down what their first lines share.
hooks.fails_when: Name what you pulled and how many. A teardown of one example is an anecdote.

hooks.name: The Stack
hooks.shape: Two named tools combined into one outcome.
hooks.example: Claude plus your analytics export gives you next week's posts in one prompt.
hooks.fails_when: Both tools must be nameable and the outcome must need both.

hooks.name: The Warning
hooks.shape: A cost the reader is about to pay.
hooks.example: Do not post another thread until you fix this one thing in your first line.
hooks.fails_when: If the cost is small the hook is a lie. Reserve it.

hooks.name: The List
hooks.shape: A counted set, with the count in the first line.
hooks.example: Seven things I would do differently if I started posting in 2026.
hooks.fails_when: The count must be exact and every item must be different in kind.

hooks.name: The Receipt
hooks.shape: Show the artifact first, explain second.
hooks.example: This is the analytics page. One post did 40% of the month's impressions. Here is why.
hooks.fails_when: Requires a real screenshot. A described receipt is not a receipt.

hooks.name: The Insider
hooks.shape: Information from inside a system.
hooks.example: X shows you which posts underperformed. Almost nobody opens the report.
hooks.fails_when: Do not claim insider access you do not have.

hooks.name: The Impossible Claim
hooks.shape: State something that sounds untrue, then prove it.
hooks.example: You can write, lint and schedule a week of posts without opening the app.
hooks.fails_when: The proof has to start within two lines or it reads as clickbait.

hooks.name: The Comparison
hooks.shape: Two named options, one winner.
hooks.example: I wrote the same post three ways. One held the fold and the other two did not.
hooks.fails_when: Say the losing option out loud. A comparison with no loser is an advert.

hooks.name: The Origin
hooks.shape: Where a result actually came from.
hooks.example: Every post on this account starts in the same 12-line file. Here it is.
hooks.fails_when: Works once per account. It is a reveal about you, and you only have one.

hooks.name: The Deadline
hooks.shape: Something is changing on a date.
hooks.example: The old bio format stops working this month. Here is what replaces it.
hooks.fails_when: Only use with a real, checkable date. This is the fastest formula to lose trust with.

hooks.name: The Direct Address
hooks.shape: Name the exact reader in the first six words.
hooks.example: If you have under a thousand followers, this is the only post you need this week.
hooks.fails_when: Narrow beats broad. 'If you post online' addresses nobody.
